storefront_public.note: namespace backend/src/public/ — read-only catalog (khong auth NV), khong write truc tiep; write thuc hien qua service so huu (sales/finance/supply/helpdesk)

rules: module chi INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE bang trong write cua minh (lint bang parse SQL trong verify)
doc bang ngoai ownership chi qua VIEW v_* hoac goi service so huu
finance cam UPDATE orders/order_items/shipments/stock_moves truc tiep — phai qua sales.setOrderPaid(conn,...)
supply cam INSERT/UPDATE debts/payments — phai qua finance.createPayable(conn,...)
sales cam INSERT/UPDATE debts/shipments/stock_moves/payments — phai qua finance/supply service
auth la module duy nhat write refresh_tokens; hr khong write users (chi doc de hien thi)
backend/src/public/ chi SELECT products/services/banners/promotions + resolve gia; moi write don/webhook di qua sales/finance/supply/helpdesk service
